Book correction: Point 2 speaks of "the following two theorems", but no theorems are printed after it: the book goes straight on to Example 66. (In mechanics books these are usually the theorems of parallel axes and perpendicular axes.) Nothing in the examples or in Exercise 3.7 needs them; everything below is done directly from I = \int r^{2}\,dm.
